summary:
Threads, sockets and DSP in this area are already portable. All threading is GThread/GMutex/GCond/GPrivate plus C11 stdatomic. Networking goes through libcurl (Icecast PUT and metadata) and GIO GSocketClient (SHOUTcast). dsp.c, loudness.c, rhythm.c and tempo.c (FFmpeg avfilter only) contain no OS calls. None of the files use pthread, sched/rtkit, clock_gettime/nanosleep, signals, /proc, /dev/urandom, flock, rename/link or fork.

The Linux-specific code is concentrated in the file-access layers of decoder.c and analyzer.c. They walk every path component with openat(O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY), check file identity with lstat/fstat (st_dev/st_ino/st_mtim/st_ctim), read with pread, stage imports with mkdirat/openat(O_CREAT|O_EXCL)/unlinkat/fchmod, and fsync the directory. They also split paths on '/' and compare prefixes with '/'. None of this compiles on mingw. output.c (WAV open with O_CLOEXEC, lseek, fsync) and transition.c (g_mkstemp_full with O_CLOEXEC, no O_BINARY) have smaller versions of the same problem. Text-mode default would corrupt every WAV, staged copy and preview.

Recommended Windows design, with Win32-only implementations in platform.c:
- **File identity:** VolumeSerialNumber + 128-bit FileId + EndOfFile + LastWriteTime. Read it from GetFileInformationByHandleEx for an open file, and from a FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT handle (or GetFileInformationByName on Win11 24H2+) for a path. ChangeTime is deliberately not compared.
- **No-follow opens:** a "held chain" walk. Each directory component is opened with FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY and without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so no component can be swapped for a junction. Name-surrogate reparse points are rejected, the leaf is opened with OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, and the code converts to a CRT fd.
- **pread:** ReadFile with an OVERLAPPED offset.
- **Directory fsync:** a no-op.
- **Sharing modes are now part of the contract:** decoder READ|DELETE, analyzer READ|WRITE|DELETE, recorder READ|DELETE. This keeps the UI's "unload, then delete the preview" working.
- **Path rules:** reject ':' (NTFS alternate data streams), device namespaces and reserved names. Prefix checks are separator-aware and case-insensitive. The relative_path sent to the backend uses '/'.
- **64-bit offsets:** the 2 GiB media limit does not fit a 32-bit off_t, so offsets stay 64-bit.

engine.c needs four changes:
- **Render priority and timers:** MMCSS "Pro Audio" on the render thread, timeBeginPeriod(1), an EcoQoS/timer-resolution opt-out (Windows 11 ignores timer requests from minimized apps otherwise) and a keep-awake request. The render loop polls every 3 ms, the other loops every 10–20 ms.
- **Stack:** link every exe with an 8 MiB stack, and move the two 500-item RadioSAudioRunItem arrays (about 732 KB each) to the heap.
- **Time zones:** use the ICU-backed time-zone wrapper. GLib rejects IANA ids on Windows, and core loudness_policy.c's /usr/share/zoneinfo file test makes apply_preferences fail even for "UTC".
- **Backend contract:** the spec documents what the engine expects from the WASAPI backend (played_tag = position the device actually played, flush, configure_output, a cheap reconnect).

Other runtime items: ship libmp3lame (the mp3_mf fallback cannot encode FLTP), use CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA for https mounts, and init curl once per process. Tests need Windows helpers and rewrites: junctions instead of symlinks, sparse truncate, pwrite, a GIO HTTP fixture instead of BSD sockets, and no 0600 mode asserts.
files_touched: src/audio/tempo.c (verification only; possible fallback to avfilter_graph_send_command)
include/radios/audio.h (pulse_server reinterpreted as backend hint; comment wording)
include/radios/platform.h (new APIs listed in spec section 2)
src/core/loudness_policy.c (cross-area: TZDIR file test + time zone wrapper)
key_decisions: Windows-only implementation: replace POSIX file access in decoder.c and analyzer.c with platform APIs. Identity is a struct of volume serial + FileId128 + size + LastWriteTime. Open paths use a held-chain no-follow walk. pread is ReadFile with an OVERLAPPED offset. No POSIX fallback.
Identity equality excludes ChangeTime. Backup tools clearing the Archive bit, OneDrive pin state and similar attribute changes would otherwise fail on-air decks with CHANGED.

Sharing modes become part of the contract. Decoder handle: FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so writers are refused while a deck holds a verified file. Analyzer: READ|WRITE|DELETE, with changes caught by its second SHA-256 pass. Recorder: READ|DELETE. Staged copy: READ|DELETE. Transition temp file: closed before deletion. The lead must confirm deny-write for the decoder; the alternative is Linux-parity full sharing.

The held-chain walk opens every directory component with FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY and without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so no component can be renamed or replaced by a junction. Only name-surrogate reparse points are rejected; cloud placeholders are not links, but are rejected with a 'download first' IO error. NtCreateFile(RootDirectory) is the documented fallback if the walk blocks other processes too much.
Every fd is binary and non-inheritable (_O_BINARY|_O_NOINHERIT, or CreateFileW handles wrapped with _open_osfhandle). g_mkstemp_full must get _O_BINARY explicitly.

Path policy for media and recording paths: strict absolute form (X:\ or UNC); no ':' after the drive letter (alternate data streams); no \\?\ or \\.\ prefixes, reserved device names, or trailing dot/space. Confinement prefix checks are separator-aware and case-insensitive. RadioSMediaAnalysis.relative_path is always '/'-separated.
analyzer stage_file copies with explicit-offset pread instead of read(), and closes the destination before radios_dir_unlink on failure; directory fsync and fchmod are no-ops.

Engine realtime hooks: MMCSS 'Pro Audio' on radios-render; refcounted timeBeginPeriod(1) plus ProcessPowerThrottling opt-out (EXECUTION_SPEED and IGNORE_TIMER_RESOLUTION); SetThreadExecutionState keep-awake while a realtime engine exists. Keep g_get_real_time/g_get_monotonic_time.
Link all executables with -Wl,--stack,8388608 and move the 500-item RadioSAudioRunItem arrays (engine.c:2961, 3389; planner.c:1104, 1724) to the heap.
Engine time zones go through radios_time_zone_new_identifier (ICU IANA-to-Windows mapping per PLATFORM_FACTS) at engine.c:1113 and 1195. Core must drop the TZDIR file test.
libcurl: one process-wide init; CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA for https Icecast mounts. Ship libmp3lame and smoke-test the encoder lookup.
Keep the radios_audio_engine_new(realtime, pulse_server) signature; pulse_server becomes a backend hint, with a suggested 'null' headless backend for CI.
risks: The decoder deny-write sharing policy changes observable behaviour: tag editors get 'file in use' while a track is loaded, and tests/test_audio_decoder.c changed_file must be rewritten.
The held directory chain blocks other processes (e.g. SDBASE moves) from renaming or deleting directories on the path while an open or import is in progress.
Legacy profile junctions and folders mounted as volumes are rejected like symlinks (IO/CONFINEMENT), which may surprise operators.
Without the core time-zone wrapper and loudness_policy fix, radios_audio_engine_apply_preferences always fails on Windows (it rejects even 'UTC').
FFmpeg 8.x (libavfilter 12) may change how atempo reacts to av_opt_set_double on an initialized filter (tempo.c:101). Verify test_tempo first.
If libmp3lame is missing, FFmpeg may fall back to mp3_mf, which cannot encode FLTP, and streaming fails.
Without timer-resolution and EcoQoS opt-out, a minimized RadioS on Windows 11 wakes every 15.6 ms and may be throttled, which shrinks render margins and can cause dropouts.

NTFS updates LastWriteTime at handle cleanup, so in-place writes through a still-open writer handle are not detected by identity alone. The analyzer's double hash covers this; the decoder relies on deny-write.
-Wl,--wrap=g_get_real_time does not intercept dllimport'ed GLib calls on Windows (affects tests that wrap engine clock usage).
With _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64, mingw redefines stat as _stat64, so a GStatBuf passed between app code and the GLib DLL may not match. Avoid g_stat/g_lstat in such code (tests included).
OneDrive cloud placeholders, Defender scans, and Controlled Folder Access (blocks recordings in Documents/Music) surface as IO errors at runtime.
GetFileInformationByName exists only on Windows 11 24H2+. The fallback path-identity check costs one CreateFileW per decoder read check (about 24/s per playing deck).
cross_area_dependencies: platform.h/platform.c: file identity API, path policy helpers, held-chain no-follow open plus RadioSDir API, pread/write_all/lseek64/fsync/create-exclusive/mkstemp_private, Win32-to-errno mapping, MMCSS/timer-resolution/power helpers, radios_time_zone_new_identifier, curl init and TLS defaults, secure zero (exact signatures in spec section 2).

Build/packaging: -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64, -Wl,--stack,8388608 on every exe, link -lavrt -lwinmm, manifest longPathAware, ship libmp3lame-0.dll, ship GLib gspawn helpers for tests, ffmpeg.exe on the test PATH.

WASAPI backend area: implement the audio_internal.h backend contract the engine relies on (played_tag = position the device actually played, via IAudioClock; consumed_frames at 48 kHz; flush/flush_buses; configure_output with output_resampler; cheap reconnect every 20 ms; endpoint ids ≤512 bytes; '@default' sentinel; non-empty error text only on real loss). Also MMCSS on its own threads, an optional engine wake-up, and a 'null' headless backend for CI.
Core: loudness_policy.c:31-35 must drop the TZDIR /usr/share/zoneinfo file test and validate through the time-zone wrapper; all g_time_zone_new_identifier(IANA) call sites must move to the wrapper.
Core config: project_root/import_root/cache_root as canonical X:\ paths without the \\?\ prefix and with consistent casing (analyzer confinement check).
Patchbay area: validate the recorder file-name prefix with radios_path_local_valid before radios_audio_output_start_record.
Playout planner: move the 500-item RadioSAudioRunItem stack arrays (planner.c:1104, 1724) to the heap.

SDBASE/Python: receives native Windows source_path/source_root (media_jobs.c:130-133); moves staged files with retry on sharing violation (Defender); renames over library files should use POSIX-semantics rename so open decoder handles (FILE_SHARE_DELETE) do not block it.

Test infrastructure: tests/platform_test.h helpers (symlink-or-skip, junction, sparse truncate, open_write with full sharing, pwrite, POSIX-semantics replace), a GIO HTTP fixture for test_output.c, and a replacement for --wrap on dllimport'ed GLib symbols.
platform_api_needs: typedef struct { RadioSFileKind kind /*MISSING,REGULAR,DIRECTORY,LINK(name-surrogate reparse),OTHER(non-disk)*/; guint64 volume; guint8 id[16]; guint64 size; gint64 mtime /*LastWriteTime 100ns*/; gint64 ctime /*informational*/; guint32 attributes; guint32 reparse_tag; } RadioSFileIdentity;

int radios_file_identity_fd(int fd, RadioSFileIdentity *out) — fstat: FileIdInfo (fallback GetFileInformationByHandle), FileBasicInfo, FileStandardInfo, FileAttributeTagInfo, GetFileType; 0 or -1+errno

int radios_file_identity_path(const gchar *utf8, RadioSFileIdentity *out) — lstat (never follows): GetFileInformationByName(FileStatBasicByNameInfo) when available, else CreateFileW(FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, share R|W|D, OPEN_REPARSE_POINT|BACKUP_SEMANTICS)+queries; MISSING + -1/ENOENT if absent
gboolean radios_file_identity_same(const RadioSFileIdentity *a, const RadioSFileIdentity *b) — kind, volume, id, size, mtime equal (ctime excluded)
gboolean radios_path_is_absolute(const gchar *utf8) — only X:\ or \\server\share (stricter than g_path_is_absolute)

gboolean radios_path_local_valid(const gchar *utf8, GError **error) — rejects ':' after the drive letter (alternate data streams), \\?\ and \\.\ prefixes, reserved device names, trailing dot/space, control and <>"|?* characters
gboolean radios_path_has_dir_prefix(const gchar *path, const gchar *root, gsize *rest) — separator-aware, ordinal case-insensitive (CompareStringOrdinal)
gchar *radios_path_to_portable(const gchar *native_relative) — '\\' to '/'

int radios_open_nofollow(const gchar *utf8_abs, RadioSOpenFlags flags /*READ, SHARE_WRITE, SEQUENTIAL*/) — held-chain walk (directory handles with FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, share R|W, no DELETE); leaf opened with OPEN_REPARSE_POINT; default share READ|DELETE; returns a binary, non-inheritable CRT fd; errno ENOENT/ELOOP/EISDIR/ENODEV/EBUSY/EACCES/EIO

RadioSDir *radios_dir_open_nofollow(const gchar *utf8_abs_dir); RadioSDir *radios_dir_open_child(RadioSDir *parent, const gchar *name, gboolean create) /*mkdirat(EEXIST ok)+openat(O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW); ELOOP on link*/; int radios_dir_create_file(RadioSDir *dir, const gchar *name) /*CREATE_NEW, GENERIC_WRITE|DELETE, share READ|DELETE, binary non-inheritable fd*/; int radios_dir_unlink(RadioSDir *dir, const gchar *name) /*FileDispositionInfoEx with POSIX semantics, fallback DeleteFileW*/; int radios_dir_identity(RadioSDir *dir, RadioSFileIdentity *out); int radios_dir_sync(RadioSDir *dir) /*no-op 0*/; const gchar *radios_dir_path(const RadioSDir *dir); void radios_dir_close(RadioSDir *dir)

gssize radios_pread(int fd, void *buf, gsize count, gint64 offset) — ReadFile with OVERLAPPED offset on a synchronous handle; ERROR_HANDLE_EOF returns 0; errno never 0 on failure; documented to move the file pointer
gboolean radios_write_all(int fd, const void *data, gsize size) — _write loop, ≤INT_MAX per call
gint64 radios_lseek64(int fd, gint64 offset, int whence) — _lseeki64
int radios_fsync(int fd) — FlushFileBuffers(_get_osfhandle(fd))
int radios_fchmod_private(int fd) — no-op, returns 0
int radios_open_create_exclusive(const gchar *utf8_abs) — WAV recorder: CREATE_NEW, GENERIC_WRITE, share READ|DELETE, binary non-inheritable fd; EEXIST if present
int radios_mkstemp_private(gchar *tmpl_utf8) — g_mkstemp_full(tmpl, O_RDWR|_O_BINARY|_O_NOINHERIT, 0600)
int radios_errno_from_win32(DWORD error) — mapping table in spec section 2.4 (sharing violation→EBUSY, file exists→EEXIST, disk full→ENOSPC, stopped on symlink→ELOOP, default EIO)
void radios_secure_zero(gpointer data, gsize size) — SecureZeroMemory

gpointer radios_thread_audio_priority_begin(const gchar *task) / void radios_thread_audio_priority_end(gpointer cookie) — AvSetMmThreadCharacteristicsW / AvRevertMmThreadCharacteristics, fallback THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST

void radios_timer_resolution_acquire(void) / void radios_timer_resolution_release(void) — refcounted timeBeginPeriod(1)/timeEndPeriod(1) plus SetProcessInformation(ProcessPowerThrottling, ControlMask=EXECUTION_SPEED|IGNORE_TIMER_RESOLUTION(0x4), StateMask=0)
void radios_power_keep_awake(gboolean on) — refcounted SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS|ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED|ES_AWAYMODE_REQUIRED)
GTimeZone *radios_time_zone_new_identifier(const gchar *iana_or_windows_id) — ICU ucal_getWindowsTimeZoneID mapping, then g_time_zone_new_identifier (per PLATFORM_FACTS)
void radios_curl_global_init(void) — once per process before threads; void radios_curl_apply_tls_defaults(CURL *curl) — CURLOPT_SSL_OPTIONS |= CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA

Test helpers (tests/platform_test.h): radios_test_symlink(target, link, directory) (-1 with errno=EPERM when unprivileged, so the test can skip), radios_test_junction(target_dir, link_dir), radios_test_truncate(path, gint64 size, gboolean sparse), radios_test_open_write(path) (share R|W|D), radios_test_pwrite(fd, data, size, gint64 offset), radios_test_replace(source, target) (POSIX-semantics rename-over)
